arms.a3_ref_feature: pristine LogisticRegressionCV, reference log-odds as a standardised feature
arms.a4_ref_feature_x100: same, reference column x100 (nearly free coefficient)

arms.a7_anchored_cv: anchored, (kappa, anchor_strength, C) by CV (ours, general)
arms.a8_kcv_no_source_cols: ablation: a6 without the columns the reference is built from

arms.a9_local_insample: ablation: same reference, in-sample on the training rows (leaks)
arms.a10_lgbm_init: LightGBM started at kappa_cv x reference (init_score)
arms.v_kappa_1se: offset, kappa by the one-SE rule toward kappa = 1, C toward the strongest ridge
arms.v_k1_1se: control: offset kappa = 1, C by the same one-SE rule
arms.v_free_1se: control: reference as an unpenalised column, C by the same one-SE rule
